models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
User account records for authentication.

Stores credentials for individual users who create and manage their own todo items. Each user has exclusive ownership of their todo list and cannot access others' data. Authentication is stateless using JWT tokens, so this table contains only the minimum required information to verify user identity: a unique email address and a bcrypt-hashed password. No other user metadata is stored to preserve privacy and simplicity.

Users are identified by a system-generated UUID primary key and authenticated by email/password combination. All todo items reference this table via user_id foreign key to enforce strict data isolation.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's unique email address used for authentication. Must be unique across all users and match standard email format.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hash of the user's password. Never stored in plaintext. Required for authentication and used to verify login credentials. Generated with cost factor 12.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
Personal to-do items owned exclusively by authenticated users.

Represents individual tasks that a user creates, views, updates, and deletes. Each todo item is bound to exactly one user and cannot be shared, transferred, or accessed by any other user.

The system enforces strict ownership: a todo item can only be modified or deleted by the user who created it. This table contains only the data necessary for task persistence: the text content, completion status, and timestamps. No additional metadata, tags, categories, or priorities are stored.

All todo items are displayed in chronological order. The completion status can be toggled between true and false any number of times. Upon deletion, the item is permanently removed from the system with no possibility of recovery.

This table does not support versioning, auditing, or backup features. It serves as the single, unified source of truth for a user's personal task list.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner of this todo item. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: text
plainFields.description: The textual content of the todo item. Must be between 1 and 255 characters and cannot be empty or contain only whitespace. This represents the user's task description.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: The completion status of the todo item. Value is false when created, and can be toggled to true by the user to mark the item as complete. Can be toggled back to false if the user wants to unmark it.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the todo item was created. Always set on insertion and never modified afterwards.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update to the todo item. Updated whenever the text or completed status change.
